channel.title: Wire — Go
channel.description: Go from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: How to Build a Coding Agent Harness in Go
item.description: Build an agent harness from scratch in Go: a chat loop, an agent loop, file and shell tools, and guardrails, running free on a local Ollama model. (1 source: golangweekly)

item.title: Preconfigured Agents with Microsoft Agent Framework for Go
item.description: Use harness.AgentConfig to configure task lists, file memory, skills, approvals, conversation history, and tracing for agents written in Go. (1 source: golangweekly)

item.title: Why Does gRPC Configure Clients with JSON?
item.description: gRPC's service config controls load balancing, retries, and timeouts, and in grpc-go you write it as a raw JSON string. Here's why, and why it shouldn't still be the only option. (1 source: golangweekly)

item.title: Comparing Go GUI Frameworks: One GUI App, Built Five Ways
item.description: I had coding agents build the same data-heavy app with Fyne, Cogent Core, Wails, GoTTH and MIQT, then measured what a user would actually notice. (1 source: golangweekly)

item.title: the story of how it got there
item.description: The lore of how Pion got DTLS 1.3, and DTLS explained with interactive demos you can play with! (1 source: golangweekly)
